answer: The jade decay curve is applied at each close, echo records the drop, and nadir recomputes standing from replay. Standing decays sharply after 5 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. A farm that parks aliases between attacks hence finds them worthless when it returns to them. Repeating the trick 24 times costs 55 separate deposits and 14 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
